LanguageData.LP_Ascend.label: lich ritual
LanguageData.LP_Ascend.description: The pawn performing this bill becomes a lich. Assign the performer in the details. Crafts and binds a phylactery and adds the three archite genes lich soul core, necrotic touch and undead body; the original genes are kept.
LanguageData.LP_Offer.label: sacrifice raw meat
LanguageData.LP_Offer.description: Consume 100 fresh raw meat to gain 100 phylactery XP. Different kinds of raw meat can be mixed.
LanguageData.LP_Rebuild.label: reshape lich body
LanguageData.LP_Rebuild.description: A legacy bill, no longer used. A lich with an undead body revives automatically through an intact phylactery 3 days after death, consuming no materials.
LanguageData.LP_MakeSkeleton.label: make skeleton servant seed
LanguageData.LP_MakeSkeleton.description: Make a seed from 50 fresh raw meat. Select the product to open the configuration screen, add raw meat, steel and plasteel to customize starting stats, then confirm to awaken. Seeds don't take command capacity yet; capacity is checked on awakening.
LanguageData.LP_MakeGolem.label: make flesh golem seed
LanguageData.LP_MakeGolem.description: Make a seed from 300 fresh raw meat. Select the product to open the configuration screen, add raw meat, steel and plasteel to customize starting stats, then confirm to awaken. Seeds don't take command capacity yet; capacity is checked on awakening.
LanguageData.LP_Refill.label: supply flesh golem
LanguageData.LP_Refill.description: Consume 100 raw meat to give 100 flesh to the friendly golem on the same map with the lowest reserve that is missing at least 100. Max reserve 500.
LanguageData.LP_HarvestBrain.label: seal brain
LanguageData.LP_HarvestBrain.description: Consume a fresh humanlike corpse to get one soul-sealed brain. Requires the corresponding intact natural organ; the whole corpse is consumed by the ritual and can't be extracted again.
